comment: Component kit defaults (docs/design/04 §1, 08 §10). 'art.include' lists the assets/registry.json ids the UI art catalog preloads (Cli.BuildUiArt): a plain entry is an id prefix, an entry with one '*' matches any ids between its two halves (so 'enemy.*.base' takes each enemy's base frame and none of its state frames); screens name backgrounds by registry id in ui/screens.json. 'meter.kinds' are the Meter kinds (each becomes the USS class meter--<kind>). 'handFan': degrees between neighbouring cards, the widest total spread, and the card count after which the hand scrolls. 'tooltip.sizes' are WT0-WT3 (USS class tooltip--<size>). 'boot.filesPerFrame' paces the determinate boot bar over the manifest. 'card.costKinds' are the cost pips in order (actions, stamina, mana); 'card.refusalTooltip' is the tooltip size that explains an unplayable card. 'combat' names the W-07 art by template: the battlefield background per region ({region}), the fallback when that art is missing, and each enemy's figure ({id}). 'combatant.statusChips' caps the status chips before the last one reads '+N' (04 W-07 lower stack).
